candidates.property-based-testing: generated-domain contracts for data transforms/codecs, not statistical modelling.
candidates.security-analysis: investigate concrete UI/API attack paths or scanner findings; not styling-only changes.
candidates.app-security-gate: test changed application trust boundaries before release.
candidates.verification-before-completion: verify factual/action completion claims rather than accepting executive-sounding prose.
candidates.verification-gauntlet: only for multiple material evidence surfaces; broader verification discipline when multiple evidence surfaces matter.
candidates.security-and-hardening: access controls, PII, row-level security and data trust boundaries.
candidates.source-driven-development: version-specific technical contracts; current platform/API/policy behavior when it affects execution.
candidates.react-composition-patterns: repair demonstrated reusable-component API pressure (boolean-prop proliferation, compound components, shared provider contracts) without abstracting ordinary one-off UI.
candidates.mobile-runtime-engineering: Expo/React Native hydration, navigation, offline mutation states and measured device performance; not visual inspiration or Flutter implementation.
candidates.data-analysis-quality: validate campaign/funnel/cohort claims before drawing conclusions.
candidates.artifact-production: usable board/report/deck files when a reusable artifact is requested.
candidates.supabase-postgres-best-practices: PostgreSQL/Supabase-specific guidance **only when that stack is actually present**.
candidates.spec-kit-workflow: only when Spec Kit is present or explicitly requested; opt-in Spec Kit artifact/toolchain specialization; use one spec pipeline, not two.
candidates.spec-driven-development: explicit requirements, scope and acceptance criteria.
candidates.reference-intelligence: source-role/provenance judgment; current competitor/market/launch evidence and source provenance.
candidates.marketing-and-growth: main marketing operating skill. Its references contain the distilled large marketing-prompt corpus, SEO/growth loop and launch/content system.
candidates.stop-slop: optional alternative editorial pass to humanizer; do not stack rigid style rules or remove factual qualifications.
candidates.humanizer: preserve claims and brand voice while removing generic/robotic wording, structural AI tells and unsupported hype.
candidates.executive-orchestration: single accountable executive synthesis, model-owned specialist selection, bounded fan-out, conflict resolution, company context and authority boundaries.
